key_headwinds: ECL norms effective April 2027 may impact balance sheet strength
Industry growth rate remains below TMB's performance

guidance_items.verbatim_quote: We expect EBITDA margin to remain stable at 18.5%.
Revenue is projected to reach INR 12,000 crores in H1 FY27.
We plan to invest INR 800 crores in capital expenditure in FY27.
